: g‘altakdagi tok o‘zgarganda uning o‘z: : when the current in a coil changes, its own magnetic flux changes and an emf appears in the coil itself: ε_self = −L·ΔI/Δt. It opposes the change in current.
: g‘altakdan o‘tuvchi magnit oqimi o‘zga: : when the magnetic flux through a coil changes, an emf appears in it and a current flows in the closed circuit (the galvanometer needle deflects). The emf is proportional to the rate of change of flux: ε = −NΔΦ/Δt.
: induksion tok shunday yo‘naladiki, uni: : the induced current flows so that its magnetic field opposes the change in flux. When the magnet approaches, the coil faces it with the same pole (repels); when it moves away — with the opposite pole (attracts).
: ramka magnit maydonda aylanganda undan: : when a frame rotates in a magnetic field, the flux through it Φ = BS cosωt varies periodically and an emf appears: ε = NBSω·sinωt. This is the conversion of mechanical energy into electrical energy.
Faradey tajribasida magnit — nuqtaviy di: In Faraday’s experiment the magnet is a point dipole and the flux through the coil is calculated with an exact formula over the turns. In “Slow” mode time is slowed down, but the emf and current are calculated at the real speed.
Halqalar bilan — sinusoidal o‘zgaruvchan: With slip rings — sinusoidal alternating current; with a commutator — unidirectional but pulsating current.
Kalit ulanganda L₁ lampa darhol yonadi,: When the switch is closed, lamp L₁ lights immediately while L₂ (with the coil) lights with a delay. When the switch is opened, the energy stored in the coil W = LI²/{#} drives a current through the lamps — L₁ flashes briefly and goes out.
Kalit ulanganda g‘altakli shoxchada tok: When the switch is closed the current in the coil branch rises slowly (τ = L/R); when it is opened the coil current decays through the first lamp — the lamp flashes.
Kalitni ulang va uzing — lampalarni kuza: Close and open the switch — watch the lamps
Kollektor ramka uchlarini har yarim ayla: The commutator swaps the frame’s ends every half-turn — the direction of the current in the external circuit does not change, but its magnitude pulsates.
Lens qoidasi: induksion tok uni hosil qi: Lenz’s law: the induced current opposes the change in flux that caused it
Magnit g‘altak ichidan o‘tadi — galvanom: The magnet passes through the coil — watch the galvanometer
Magnit g‘altak ichidan o‘tib, qaytib chi: The magnet passes through the coil and comes back out. The galvanometer needle deflects one way on entry and the other way on exit. When the magnet pauses briefly at the centre of the coil, the current is zero.
Magnit maydonda aylanayotgan ramka — gen: A frame rotating in a magnetic field — a generator
Magnit tezroq harakatlansa yoki o‘ramlar: The faster the magnet moves or the more turns there are, the greater the emf. If the magnet stops, the current vanishes.
Magnit yaqinlashganda va uzoqlashganda E: When the magnet approaches and moves away, the emf has the opposite sign. If the magnet is at rest (even inside the coil), the emf is zero — what matters is the change in flux.
Magnitni sichqoncha yoki barmoq bilan g‘: Push the magnet into the coil and pull it out with the mouse or your finger. The faster you move it, the more the galvanometer deflects; if the magnet stops, there is no current.
Magnitni sichqoncha yoki barmoq bilan su: Move the magnet with the mouse or your finger
Oqim o‘zgarmayapti — tok yo‘q: Flux is not changing — no current
O‘ramlar sonini {#} dan {#} ga oshiring: Increase the number of turns from {#} to {#} — the emf grows {#}-fold. Doubling the speed also doubles the emf.
O‘zaksiz g‘altakning induktivligi ancha: The inductance of a coil without a core is much smaller — the lamp lights almost without delay. Switch the core in and out, close the switch and compare.
Ramka kontakt halqalar orqali yuklamaga: The frame is connected to the load through slip rings. The emf varies sinusoidally, and the lamp flashes and fades every half-period (not noticeable at fast rotation).
Tajriba boshlansa, grafik shu yerda chiz: Once the experiment starts, the graph will be drawn here
har yarim aylanishda ramka uchlarini alm: swaps the frame’s ends every half-turn — the current direction in the external circuit does not change (DC generator).
orqali tashqi zanjirga o‘zgaruvchan tok: an alternating current is supplied to the external circuit. The effective value is ε_eff = ε_max/√{#}.
|Ψ| kamaymoqda: g‘altak magnitni tortadi: |Ψ| is decreasing: the coil attracts the magnet
|Ψ| ortmoqda: g‘altak magnitni itaradi: |Ψ| is increasing: the coil repels the magnet
«Kalitni ulash» ni bosing (yoki sxemani: Press “Close the switch” (or click the diagram): L₁ lights immediately, L₂ with a delay. Then open the switch — L₁ will flash briefly.
ε_o‘z = −L·ΔI/Δt: tok tez o‘zgarganda ka: ε_self = −L·ΔI/Δt: it is large when the current changes quickly (a spark when the switch is opened).
